structured: Reconstruct the existing design with clean continuous contours and sharply resolved internal detail. Resolve real slots, grille openings, fasteners and markings individually where the source shows them, retaining their exact counts, locations and thicknesses. Replace blocky sampling with coherent drawn features, without inventing missing parts. Keep existing painted bands and curved shading at their own widths; do not sharpen them into new seams. Do not omit small features simply because they are faint.
uv_atlas: This is a flat UV texture atlas. Preserve every separate piece's outline, size, position, orientation, existing distortion and surrounding padding. Reconstruct the real hard features and small mechanical or graphic details clearly; retain soft organic shading and painted transitions where the source has them. Preserve each piece's own colours independently. Keep facial features and markings inside their original pieces. Do not rearrange or join pieces, straighten distorted features, fill padding, complete unseen parts or render an assembled character or object.
soft_bands: The existing broad bands and gradients are painted colour transitions. Keep their exact positions, widths, shapes and light-to-dark profiles. Do not collapse them into thin dark seam lines, outline them or turn them into physical frames or bevels. Resolve the existing painted contours in focus while retaining softly feathered transitions; do not apply global blur. Preserve all source mottling at full strength. Add finer matte definition only where an existing painted surface supports it; a plain gradient can remain plain.
grain: The original grain and mottling are essential to this surface. Keep the major patches, furrows, crack paths and grain groupings in place, preserving their scale, direction, density and contrast. Resolve their smaller contours and internal colour variation at native resolution. Keep rough source texture rough where shown. Do not denoise it into smooth paint, replace it with generic noise, add new crack branches or exaggerate relief. Preserve any clearly drawn structural boundaries separately from the finer grain.
flat_graphic: Preserve the exact count, order, width, position and colour of the graphic regions and lines. Reconstruct their drawn contours cleanly without shifting them. Keep flat fills flat and any deliberate colour transitions smooth. Do not add material grain, surface shading, bevels, outlines, seams or decorative detail.
soft_effect: Preserve the exact footprint, paths, spacing, colours, brightness distribution and falloff of the visible light or effect pattern. Reconstruct its existing forms with smooth continuous colour transitions, keeping soft edges soft at their original widths. Do not turn luminous bands or painted networks into solid hardware, cracks, raised grids or crisp outlines. Do not add a housing, light source, new glow, material grain or a different background.
smooth_gradient: This is a deliberately smooth colour swatch. Match the original gradient direction, transition positions and tonal profile. Keep uniform regions uniform and straight transitions straight. Do not add grain, mottling, clouds, surface relief, sharpening lines or a material interpretation. Preserve any existing narrow tonal step at its actual width without turning it into a seam.
